name: Metronic Global Berhad
overview: 2026年，Metronic Global Berhad 通过子公司 MGL Development 以 RM33,240,000 收购了 81 套服务式公寓，扩大了物业发展板块；同时，通过子公司 Metronic Engineering 以 RM9,420,000 出售了一处工业用地及三层半独立式工厂。公司未公告新的工程合约或系统集成项目。
overview_en: In 2026, Metronic Global Berhad expanded its property development segment through its subsidiary MGL Development, acquiring 81 serviced apartments for RM33,240,000, while its subsidiary Metronic Engineering disposed of an industrial land with a three-storey semi-detached factory for RM9,420,000. No new engineering contracts or system integration projects were announced.

segments.name: 物业发展
segments.note: 今年通过子公司 MGL Development 收购了 81 套服务式公寓，扩大物业发展业务。
segments.note_en: This year, through subsidiary MGL Development, acquired 81 serviced apartments, expanding the property development business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 MGL Development 与 Sanichi Precision Mould 签订 81 份买卖协议，以 RM33,240,000 收购位于 Melaka, Klebang 的 Marina Point 81 套服务式公寓。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary MGL Development entered into 81 sale and purchase agreements with Sanichi Precision Mould to acquire 81 serviced apartments at Marina Point, Klebang, Melaka, for RM33,240,000.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年子公司出售了一处工业用地及工厂，该资产与现有业务板块无直接对应关系。
segments.note_en: This year, a subsidiary disposed of an industrial land and factory; this asset does not directly correspond to any existing business segment.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 Metronic Engineering 与 Twin Hydraulics Engineering 签订买卖协议，以 RM9,420,000 出售位于 Shah Alam, Bukit Jelutong 的一处永久工业用地及三层半独立式工厂。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary Metronic Engineering entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Twin Hydraulics Engineering to dispose of a freehold industrial land with a three-storey semi-detached factory at Bukit Jelutong, Shah Alam, for RM9,420,000.
